latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of A Video Using: create and export edited videos via AI.

- Describe desired edits (trim, add music, export) and quickly get finished MP4 videos—no manual editing required.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (and more) up to 500MB; all rendering happens on remote GPU servers.
- Built-in workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinements; each export completes in 1–2 minutes for short clips.
- First-run setup automatically obtains a 7-day token for 100 free credits—no registration required.
- Includes automatic session management, file format guidance, error codes, and concise user feedback throughout editing and export.
- Requires environment variable NEMO_TOKEN for authentication.
